rows.grounds: describes the form of the entablature (prastaraṃ) mentioned in the previous verse
fused form sabhā-ākāram + atha + api presenting an alternative shape
marks the alternative between prescribed forms

items.question: What alternative shapes are prescribed for the entablature in this architectural construction?
premises: The entablature may be made umbrella-shaped.
The umbrella-shaped entablature is to be furnished with a head.
Alternatively, the entablature may be made assembly-hall-shaped.
items.inference: The construction rules permit either an umbrella-shaped entablature with a head or an assembly-hall-shaped entablature.
uncertainties: The precise architectural referent of śiras in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: The entablature should be made umbrella-shaped with a head, or alternatively shaped like an assembly hall.
